title: S.R.&O. 3 of 2026 National Honours and Awards Proclamation, 2026
text:
A 71
National Honours and Awards
2026 Proclamation SRO. 3
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS
NO. 3 OF 2026
BY THE GOVERNOR-GENERAL
A PROCLAMATION L.S.
CCÉÉCCIILLEE EELLLLEENN FFLLEEUURREETTTTEE LLAA GGRREENNAADDEE
Governor-General.
WHEREAS it is enacted by section 10 of the
National Honours and Awards Act, Chapter 204A that,
each year on Independence Day or at such other times
as may be expedient, it shall be lawful for the Governor-
General, acting on the advice of the Prime Minister on
the recommendation of the National Awards Advisory
Committee, to confer awards on persons, living or
dead who have rendered distinguished and meritorious
service to the nation of Grenada or who are otherwise
deemed worthy of such awards;
WHEREAS the nation of Grenada is celebrating 52
years of independence on 7th February 2026;
AND WHEREAS the National Awards Advisory
Committee has submitted a recommendation to the
Prime Minister, and the Prime Minister has advised the
Governor-General that eleven (11) persons be awarded
for distinguished and meritorious service to the nation
of Grenada;
NOW THEREFORE, I, CÉCILE ELLEN
FLEURETTE LA GRENADE, Dame Grand Cross of
the Most Distinguished Order of Saint Michael and
Saint George, Officer of the Most Excellent Order
of the British Empire, Governor-General in and over
Grenada, am graciously pleased to approve awards
with effect from 7th February 2026, Independence
Day, to the under-mentioned:

A 72
National Honours and Awards
SRO. 3 2026
Proclamation
MOST DISTINGUISHED ORDER OF
THE NATION
KNIGHT GRAND COLLAR
Mr. Kent Joseph
For distinguished and outstanding service to
Grenada
KNIGHT GRAND CROSS
Mr. Walter Clement Noel
For distinguished and outstanding service
to Grenada
COMPANION OF THE ORDER
OF GRENADA
Mr. Richardo Keens-Douglas
For distinguished achievements that have brought
international prestige to Grenada
ORDER OF GRENADA GOLD AWARD
FOR EXCELLENCE
Mrs. Catherine John
For exemplary and outstanding service to Grenada
SPICE ISLE AWARD
Ms. Michaele Hercules
For emulative service to Grenada in Sports
Mrs. Brigid Logan
For emulative service to Grenada in Culture
CAMERHOGNE AWARD
Dr. Deborah-Ann Stephens-John
For meritorious service to Grenada

A 73
National Honours and Awards
2026 Proclamation SRO. 3
Mr. James Clarkson
For meritorious service to Grenada
MEDAL OF HONOUR
Mr. T. Cheney Joseph
For meritorious and productive service to
Grenada in Sports
Mr. Samuel Britton
For meritorious and productive service to Grenada
in Community Mentorship
Mrs. Jean Jacqueline Small
For meritorious and productive service to Grenada
in Community Mentorship
GIVEN under my hand and the Public Seal of
Grenada, this 4th day of March Two
Thousand and Twenty-Six in the fourth
year of the reign of HIS MAJESTY KING
CHARLES THE THIRD.
GOD SAVE THE KING.
GRENADA
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, AT
THE GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE, ST. GEORGE’S
6/3/2026.
